policy: No screenshot is shown as a numbered-step illustration merely because it depicts GTA VI, the same topic, or a similar mechanic. Match exact action, exact chapter/mode and source. In the absence of positive evidence, show no image; retain source links and add to editorial backlog only. Location-reference screenshots may appear only under the exact corresponding location step and must be visibly labelled as references, not proof of the action or loot. A visible, small source link is required directly beneath each image. All rights remain with their respective holders; captioning does not imply redistribution permission.
